requirements: Users are enrolled in courses (enrollments) or teach them (teaching). Teachers see, create and edit the assignments of their courses; enrolled students see only published assignments. Students submit work for courses they are enrolled in, on behalf of any student (the submission names the student, not necessarily the submitter), and see their own submissions; teachers see every submission of their courses. Submissions and assignments are never deleted; submissions are never edited. A submission's student stays enrolled in its course: an enrollment with submissions cannot be removed.
expected_properties: An assignment is visible to its teachers, and to enrolled students once published.
A submission is created only by an enrolled student, in their own name.
A submission is visible only to its student and the course's teachers.
Dropping a course never grants access.
Every submitter is enrolled in the course.
The application role may only select/insert/update assignments, select/insert submissions, and select enrollments and teaching.
